about: src/lib/day_bounds_vectors.json is a byte-for-byte copy of madar-shared's file at this tag (the backend and the POS core run the same rule from madar-time day_bounds). A change is made there, released with a tag, and copied here with the tag and hash below updated; scripts/check-shared-vectors.sh (CI) and shared_vectors.test.ts check it, and lib/madar-time.test.ts runs the dashboard's dayBoundaryISO against it.
